guitar.modelsText: Custom "Arm the Homeless" guitar / Fender Telecaster "Soul Power"
guitar.notes: Tom Morello's heavily modified, sticker-and-toggle-switch-laden guitars are among the most recognizable and well-documented instruments in rock.

tone.target: tight aggressive hard-rock riff with wah bite and mid-forward crunch
tone.profile: tight aggressive hard-rock riff with wah bite and mid-forward crunch
tone.summary: A high-gain signal chain utilizing a Boost for initial punch, followed by Distortion for crunch, Wah for signature bite, and an AC30 TB into a UK Vintage 4x12 to achieve the required aggressive, mid-forward hard rock sound.
